summary: Practise sustainability assurance planning, evidence evaluation, and controls testing with framework-based case files. Explore the course and build practical sk
lede: Sustainability information assurance evaluates reported disclosures and supporting evidence against suitable criteria. This training is for assurance practitioners, internal auditors, finance leaders and sustainability reporting teams who need to plan and perform reviewable engagements. Participants practise risk-based scoping and materiality assessment, test controls and data lineage, evaluate and document evidence, and draft conclusions; AI-assisted anomaly screening is covered at an operational-awareness level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, perform, oversee, or support assurance engagements over sustainability information. It suits practitioners with some exposure to audit, controls, financial reporting, or sustainability disclosures who need to strengthen evidence and engagement methods.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to audit, assurance, internal controls, sustainability reporting, or finance processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with at least one reporting or assurance workflow; advanced analytics and AI applications are introduced at conceptual or operational-awareness level rather than implementation level.
